test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options does NOT constitute a national income measurement method?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Credit method.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Credit method:-**

 
 
• **The credit method is a way of avoiding or reducing double taxation. **
 
• It works by allowing taxpayers to credit the taxes they have paid in one country against the taxes they owe in another country.
 
• This is especially important for taxpayers who live or work in multiple countries, or who receive income from multiple countries.
 
• **The credit method does not constitute a national income measurement method.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Product method:**

 
 
• This method measures the total value of all final goods and services produced in a country during a given period of time.
 
• It is also known as the value-added method.
 
 
 
• **Income method**:
 
 
• This method measures the total income earned by all factors of production (land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurship) in a country during a given period of time.
 
 
 
• **Expenditure method:**
 
 
• This method measures the total expenditure on final goods and services produced in a country during a given period of time.
